sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH floor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        COUNT(*) AS floor_count
    FROM FCLT_FLOOR f
    GROUP BY f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(floor_count) AS max_floor_count
    FROM floor_counts
)
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME
FROM floor_counts fc
JOIN max_count mc
    ON fc.floor_count = mc.max_floor_count
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

sql_reading_B.sql:
WITH building_levels AS (
    SELECT
        f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        MAX(TO_NUMBER(f.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE)) AS max_floor_level
    FROM FCLT_FLOOR f
    WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(f.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, '^[0-9]+$')
    GROUP BY f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
max_level AS (
    SELECT MAX(max_floor_level) AS global_max_level
    FROM building_levels
)
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME
FROM building_levels bl
JOIN max_level ml
    ON bl.max_floor_level = ml.global_max_level
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question_text: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.
